A light-skinned<ref name="Inside" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Starships" /> had been fired from some of the most respectable bars on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Inside" /> At some point by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}}, as depicted in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the man began working as an '''assistant bartender''' to fellow [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Bufon Taire/Legends|Bufon Taire]] at the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Inside" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref>
